typography.rationale: Manrope’s rounded geometry feels human and approachable while maintaining technical clarity—perfect for lowering defenses without losing credibility. Inter as body keeps reading fatigue low for tactical pages and email landing flows. The combination balances warmth in form with a cool palette so SaaS buyers feel welcomed yet still see process rigor.

brand_voice.voice_summary: Outreach is personable and useful—one quick win, one proof point, and an easy yes/no next step. On the site, we explain complex systems in plain English with visual cues and micro-examples. We never use slangy hype or joke at the prospect’s expense. Filter: if a founder read this on their phone between meetings, would they smile and instantly get it?
brand_voice.example_headline: Your next 100 SaaS customers—without the guesswork.

why_these_colors: Azure blues keep the palette firmly in SaaS territory while a controlled emerald accent adds energy for CTAs. The light, friendly highlight supports approachable UX patterns without drifting into lifestyle-brand territory. This gives FirstSignal a human face while still reading as process-driven and technically credible.
